specialAbility: Claim-Breaker Heat: when bloodied, he tries to hold the furnace line and draw heroes near slag.

intro.text: Borren Ashmantle has heard an old Embervein claim bell ringing beneath the hills. The mine belonged to his mother's line, but a soot-marked crew has broken in, restarted the furnaces, and stolen the First Claim Hammer from its sealed rack. This might be a task for some heroes searching for experience. Those are asked to enter through the cold lift, learn who reopened the Deepworks, defeat the thief holding the furnace heart, and bring back whatever proof survives the heat.

outro.text: With Grondel defeated, the Embervein Deepworks quiets to a low mineral breathing. The First Claim Hammer is yours for now, but the Ashmantle maker's mark is unmistakable. When the party returns home and visits Borren, the dwarf smith will recognize it and be grateful for its return.

storyTriggers.title: The Lift Drops Cold
storyTriggers.text: The lift cage shudders to a stop in a mine that should be hot but is not. Old forge marks have been hacked from the walls, and fresh soot has been rubbed over a dwarven claim sigil. Someone did not only steal ore here. Someone tried to erase ownership.

storyTriggers.title: The Stolen Ledger
storyTriggers.text: The foreman's desk is split open. Under coal dust you find repeated notes about an heirloom hammer called the First Claim. The last line is newer than the rest: "Sootbeard took it to the heart furnace. Borren must never see it again."

storyTriggers.title: Pressure Before Fire
storyTriggers.text: The pressure valve still answers to a careful hand. Opening it vents some of the gallery heat and gives the party a tactical clue: thunder, cold, water, and shut valves are how the Deepworks machinery is humbled.

storyTriggers.title: The Claim Breaks
storyTriggers.text: Grondel falls against the anvil-stone and the furnace coughs out a ring of sparks. His hammer remains warm but no longer hateful. The maker's mark under the soot is a dwarven mountain split by a clean white line: Ashmantle.

storyTriggers.title: Coal Wages
storyTriggers.text: Inside the claim vault are unpaid wages wrapped in oilcloth, a few useful supplies, and ore that still holds a stubborn orange glow. The Deepworks was not abandoned all at once. It was taken shift by shift.

designNotes.party: Four level 2 heroes. Encounters use mostly category 1 monsters with a few category 2 pressure pieces as set-piece threats.
designNotes.layout: Compact branching mine: lift -> coal split -> vent -> cooling chapel -> furnace heart, with optional office, gear gallery, vault, and hoist crossing branches. Corridors use outside-door cells only so room discovery behaves like generated dungeons.
monsterShowcase: Coal-Dust Goblins kite behind coal piles while rats interfere with frontliners.
Bent-Gear Scarabs slow movement near gear hazards so ranged enemies have time to matter.
The Furnace Mephit flies over the cooling trough and punishes clumped heroes.
The Chain Guard pulls heroes toward steam pipes and oil barrels.
Grondel uses a tougher Sootbeard Shift Boss profile, with a scarab and goblin to make target priority matter.
furniturePurpose: Coal piles and ore carts make cover/difficult terrain in early rooms.
Workbench, locker, and tool rack seed practical loot and story context.
Cooling trough, anvil, furnace, valves, gears, hoists, barrels, and slag make the dungeon feel like a dangerous workplace, not an empty cave.
